title: SRCW Pigstep Disc
description: Replaces the Pigstep music disc with the respective remix from Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds.
body:
Everyone loves Pigstep, right? What if we replaced it with the remix found in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds? The full length of the music disc is replaced, and the display text has been modified to display the proper credits of "Takahiro Kai - The Nether Track", currently in English only.
